Thanks Alden — excited to get this moving. I pulled together an "Activation & Handoff" MAP draft and a starter benchmark spreadsheet — attaching both (MAP-activation-v1.pdf, eval-benchmarks-sheet.csv). Below is a proposed distribution of responsibilities and immediate next steps.

Proposed success criteria (initial):
- Avg. extractive summary F1 >= 0.78 on held-out test set
- Clinical hallucination rate <= 2% (manual spot checks)
- Qualitative clinician acceptability >= 4/5 on sampled set

Owners (Redwood / CardioAI):
- Prompt owner (design + iteration): Marissa Cole (redwood) / Priya Shah (CardioAI)
- Bench & metrics lead: Karthik Iyer (redwood) / Alden Morris (CardioAI)
- Technical/infra lead (data access, S3 creds, run access): Hannah Schmitt (redwood) / Eng on CardioAI side

Immediate actions (this week):
1) Marissa: create first prompt pack (20 prompts covering common note types) — deliver by Fri 10/22
2) Karthik: seed benchmark sheet with target metrics and CI rules — deliver by Mon 10/21
3) Alden: share anonymized sample (50 notes) and data access method (secure share or SFTP) — by Tue 10/20
4) Hannah: schedule 45-min activation call to align owners and runbook — propose Wed 10/20 10:00–10:45 PT

Timeline (overview):
- Week 0 (Activation): align MAP, handoff creds, initial prompt pack
- Week 1–3 (Iterate): prompt tuning & bench runs (daily syncs optional)
- Week 4–5 (Evaluation): run holdout bench, clinician spot checks
- Week 6 (Decision): go/no-go + procurement/signature

Notes: we'll default to Redwood-hosted runs on a dedicated test instance to keep results consistent. If CardioAI prefers their infra, we'll coordinate run parity.

Please see the attached MAP draft for milestone acceptance language and SLO examples. If this looks good I will finalize the MAP and create a shared Drive folder with runbooks and the benchmarks sheet.
